label: ChatGPT subscription (Codex OAuth via CLIProxyAPI)
note: Reuses your ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription through a local CLIProxyAPI instance, which exposes an Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint. Run the login step once; tokens land in ~/.cli-proxy-api and hot-reload. Anthropic does not support routing Claude Code to non-Claude models through a gateway, and this path relies on a reverse-engineered OAuth flow — it may break without notice. MODEL SLOTS: opus=gpt-5.6-sol (flagship reasoning), sonnet=gpt-5.6-terra (balanced, roughly the mini tier), haiku=gpt-5.6-luna (lightweight, lowest cost). CLIProxyAPI reuses OpenAI's official model ids verbatim. CONTEXT WINDOW: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS / CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW / CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS are one client-wide value each, not per-slot. They are set to 1000000 / 1000000 / 128000 to match the gpt-5.6 family (~1.05M API context window, 128K output). 272K is a billing-tier threshold (input>272K triggers 2x/1.5x pricing), not a context cap. If you route the launcher to a smaller GPT/Codex model, lower these values yourself.

service.label: CLIProxyAPI
service.loginHint: {bin} --codex-login    # one-time browser authorization of your ChatGPT account

env.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_DESCRIPTIO: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna 轻量快速模型，性价比最高 (~1.05M 上下文 / 128K 输出)
env.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_DESCRIPTI: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Terra 均衡模型，约对应 mini 档 (~1.05M 上下文 / 128K 输出)
env.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_DESCRIPTION: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol 旗舰推理模型 (~1.05M 上下文 / 128K 输出)
env.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL_DESCRIPTIO: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna 轻量快速模型，性价比最高 (~1.05M 上下文 / 128K 输出)
